Outcome: Depressive symptoms (lower is better)

## Study A
Found: benefit
Claim: Higher serum 25(OH)D3 at age 9.8 was associated with lower depressive symptoms at age 13.8.
Sentence: "Higher concentrations of 25(OH)D(3) assessed at mean age 9.8 years were associated with lower levels of depressive symptoms at age 13.8 years [adjusted risk ratio (RR; 95% confidence interval (CI)): 0.90 (0.86-0.95)], but not at age 10.6 years [adjusted RR (95% CI): 0.98 (0.93-1.03)] and with increased odds of decreasing symptoms between age 10.6 and 13.8 years [adjusted RR (95% CI): 1.08 (1.01-1.16)]."
Measured as: depressive symptoms (Mood and Feelings Questionnaire) at age 13.8
Population: Children from a prospective cohort, mean age 9.8 years at vitamin D measurement
Intervention: Serum 25(OH)D3 concentration (measured, not given)
Comparator: Lower 25(OH)D3 concentrations
Design: cohort study
Sample size: not reported
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

## Study B
Found: harm
Claim: In PD patients given vitamin D3, folic acid and B12 for 6 months, the 15D depression dimension score significantly increased (improved) from baseline.
Sentence: "After the intervention, the mean score of speech, mental function, discomfort and symptoms, depression, and QoL significantly increased (p < 0.05 for all)."
Measured as: depression (15D dimension score)
Population: Levodopa-treated Parkinson's disease patients in Romania, mean age 71 years
Intervention: Daily tablet with 800 IU vitamin D3, 1000 µg folic acid, 15 µg vitamin B12 for 6 months
Comparator: None (single-arm, baseline vs 6 months)
Design: case series
Sample size: not reported
baseline_vitamin_d_status: not_reported

content.text: {"rationale":"Study A is a pediatric cohort linking higher measured vitamin D to fewer depressive symptoms, while Study B is a single-arm case series of a vitamin D3/folic acid/B12 combination in older Parkinson's patients, with no control group.","verdict":"genuine","reason":"design_or_bias","also_differs":["population","intervention","comparator","outcome_measure"],"detail":"design: pediatric cohort of measured serum 25(OH)D3 vs single-arm uncontrolled case series of a combination supplement in elderly Parkinson's patients"}
